title: 1990 AHSME Problem 30
statement: If \(R_n=\frac12(a^n+b^n),\) where \(a=3+2\sqrt2,\) \(b=3-2\sqrt2,\) and \(n=0,\) \(1,\) \(2,\) \(\ldots,\) then \(R_{12345}\) is an integer. Its units digit is

solutions.text:
Because \(a,b\) are roots of \(t^2-6t+1=0,\) \[ R_n=6R_{n-1}-R_{n-2}. \] Starting with \(R_0=1,\ R_1=3,\) the units digits are \[ 1,3,7,9,7,3,1,\ldots, \] with period \(6.\) Since \(12345\equiv3\pmod6,\) the units digit is the same as that of \(R_3,\) namely \(9.\)

Thus the correct answer is E.
